title: F07 — Reports and audit log
tagline: Reports and audit log end to end: Domain → fake data → view models → real data → tests.
intro: F07 · 31h · skeleton guide — full code is added when this feature starts.

blocks.html:
• Goal: Reports and audit log end to end: Domain → fake data → view models → real data → tests.
  • Demo: signed, branded PDF and CSV from a real session, shared in airplane mode; audit chain verifies.
  • Spec: 05, 07.3 audit
  • Starts from: the skeleton screens (~30% of Figma) that read App/Fakes/FakeData.swift.
  • No fake repository: the fake-data step writes the real implementation on in-memory values, registered once in App/DI/RepositoriesDI.swift; the real-data step swaps its insides, never the type. The dev menu seeds / clears it through Debug-only UseCases/DevData/ use cases; test doubles live only in test targets.

Steps

  1. Implement the Domain protocol under its real name as an actor that keeps everything in memory for now.
  2. Seed it with Eastline branding and R-0930-07 — move the values out of App/Fakes/FakeData.swift.
  3. Debug only: add resetAllData() / seedSampleData() to the repository protocol and Impl, add ResetAll<Feature>DataUseCase / Seed<Feature>DataUseCase in UseCases/DevData/, call them from DevMenuViewModel.
  4. Register it in App/DI/RepositoriesDI.swift, its DevData use cases in App/DI/UseCasesDI.swift (#if DEBUG).

Steps

  1. Add <Screen>ViewModel.swift next to the view: @MainActor @Observable, use cases through init; the view builds it with Container.shared.<useCase>(). Pushes go through coordinator.push(<Feature>Route…); add the case and its screen in <Feature>Route.swift (D19).
  2. In the view, replace FakeData… with view-model state; keep the layout (visual finish is F16).
  3. Loading, empty (DSEmptyState) and error states; previews for each.
  4. Delete this feature's Fake* types from App/Fakes/FakeData.swift once nothing uses them.

blocks.html:
4.1 Report data model and CSV
  • Goal: one-fetch SessionSnapshot and streamed CSV.
  • Spec: 05

Steps

  1. CSV columns from spec 05; stream with FileHandle.
4.2 PDF renderer
  • Goal: paginated PDF that never drops an image.
  • Spec: 05.2
ActionFileHolds
NewPackages/DomainLayer/Sources/DomainLayer/UseCases/Reports/LayOutReportUseCase.swiftPure: SessionSnapshot → [ReportPage]; counts images (a business rule, so Domain)
NewPlatformKit/Rendering/PDF/PDFPageRenderer.swiftGeneric: draws PDFPageLayout records (text, image at a frame) with UIGraphicsPDFRenderer, one autoreleasepool per page
EditDataLayer/Repositories/ReportRepositoryImpl.swiftMaps ReportPage → PDFPageLayout, calls the renderer, maps its errors

Steps

  1. Split this part when you start (layout · render · integrity footer).
  2. Temp file + atomic move.
4.3 Audit chain
  • Goal: HMAC-chained audit log, verified at launch.
  • Spec: 07.3

Steps

  1. Key generated once, Keychain only.
  2. Verify step runs async after .ready.
4.4 Real logic behind the screens
  • Goal: real issues, lock and reports; export from a real session.

  • Both groupings give the same total
  • Image count = non-excluded captures
  • 200-image memory under 200 MB
  • Hash-of-hashes order-stable
  • 100-entry chain verifies
  • Edit at 50 / mid-chain delete detected at the right index
